item.title: Pope praises young people's 'energy and commitment' at huge open-air Mass in Paris
item.description:
Pope Leo XIV spoke about technology during a speech given to French diplomats on Friday. Tom Nicholson/Getty Images Pope Leo XIV spoke to diplomats in France on Friday. The Pope cautioned against losing our humanity "amid a paradise of machines." Addressing potential risks of AI has become a central theme of his papacy. Pope Leo XIV has a new warning about AI. The Pope cautioned against an overreliance on artificial intelligence and other technology during a speech to French diplomats, including President Emmanuel Macron, on Friday. Earlier that day, he traveled from Rome to Paris as part of an apostolic journey. item.title: China and U.S. agree to establish AI safety channel and continue trade and military talks
item.description:
Chinese president’s proposals for lessening tensions come amid period of intense competition between the two countries over AI and trade Xi Jinping has called for extensive cooperation with Washington to avoid the “Thucydides trap” that could put the US and China on a military collision course amid rising tensions over artificial intelligence, trade and Taiwan. At the start of his summit meeting with Donald Trump in the White House, the Chinese president laid out terms for a mutual understanding that he said could steer the two competing superpowers away from future military conflict and on to a road of mutual gain. item.title: What did we learn from the Trump-Xi summit?
item.description:

item.title: Al Gore on the Global Climate Crisis: “We’re Going to Win This”
item.description:
This story was originally published by the Guardian and is reproduced here as part of the Climate Desk collaboration. Two decades after the release of his groundbreaking documentary An Inconvenient Truth , Al Gore has admitted he was surprised by the ferocious, ongoing backlash from the fossil fuel industry and its political allies. But the former US vice-president insists he still has optimism the world will confront the climate crisis. At a New York event to mark the 20th anniversary of the release of the film and his subsequent climate advocacy work, Gore, now 78, joked: “I always say if it hadn’t been for me, we might have a big problem right now” when asked about the progress made over the past two decades. “The scientists unfortunately have been proven to be absolutely correct,” Gore said on Wednesday. “In some important ways, they may have even understated what the damage is…
